hook: Ummadisetti has been building production generative AI systems, RAG pipelines, model fine-tuning, agentic platforms, since before the term agentic AI entered general use. At Toyota North America he leads the function responsible for autonomous AI agents in one of the world's largest automotive manufacturers, while his seat on the LangChain advisory board gives him direct influence on the open-source tooling that most agentic systems are built on.
name: Ravi Chandu Ummadisetti

quote.text: Building GEN AI for Real-World Problems.

moniker: Head of Agentic AI at Toyota North America

reading.body:
Ravi Chandu Ummadisetti holds two positions that together span both where agentic AI is deployed at scale and where the tools to build it are shaped: he leads the agentic AI function at Toyota North America and sits on the LangChain advisory board.

The career trajectory the data shows runs from data analysis through applied machine learning in banking, telecom, and healthcare, arriving at a role defined entirely by autonomous AI agents inside a major manufacturer. That progression matters because automotive manufacturing involves complex, interdependent workflows at high volume, which makes it a meaningful test environment for agentic systems, ones that must plan, act, and recover across multiple steps without continuous human direction. The LangChain advisory seat is a separate lever: LangChain is the framework the data identifies as the most widely used open-source foundation for agentic and LLM-powered applications, so influence there reaches well beyond any single organization.

What the data does not cover is the compute infrastructure or power footprint behind Toyota's agentic deployments, how many agents are in production, or what outcomes they have produced. The patent on automated meeting minutes indicates applied ML work in enterprise workflow automation, but predates the generative AI period. The record here is one of positioning, a practitioner at the intersection of large-scale deployment and foundational tooling, rather than a record of measured outcomes at either location.
